items.name: CHIC_OS
items.comment:
Compile-time operating system constant with a value of OS.Windows, OS.MacOs, or OS.Linux.

Available directly as CHIC_OS or qualified as builtin.CHIC_OS. Its value is supplied by the compiler build.
items.summary: Compile-time operating system constant with a value of OS.Windows, OS.MacOs, or OS.Linux.

items.name: CHIC_BUILD_CONFIG
items.comment:
Compile-time build configuration constant. It is BuildConfiguration.Debug when the compiler is built with CHIC_DEBUG, or BuildConfiguration.Release with CHIC_RELEASE.

Available directly as CHIC_BUILD_CONFIG or qualified as builtin.CHIC_BUILD_CONFIG.
items.summary: Compile-time build configuration constant. It is BuildConfiguration.Debug when the compiler is built with CHIC_DEBUG, or BuildConfiguration.Release with CHIC_RELEASE.

items.name: alloc
items.comment:
Allocates size bytes using the C heap and fills the storage with zeroes. Call it as builtin.alloc(size).

The memory belongs to the caller. Release it with core.libc.free when finished. For allocation status codes and arena or pool policies, use core.memory.
items.summary: Allocates size bytes using the C heap and fills the storage with zeroes. Call it as builtin.alloc(size).

items.name: get_argc
items.comment: Returns the number of command-line arguments, including the executable name at index 0. Call it as builtin.get_argc().
items.summary: Returns the number of command-line arguments, including the executable name at index 0. Call it as builtin.get_argc().

items.name: get_arg
items.comment:
Returns the command-line argument at index as a string. Call it as builtin.get_arg(index).

Use an index from 0 up to, but excluding, builtin.get_argc(). Index 0 is the executable name. The returned string refers to the process argument storage; do not free it or its data pointer.
items.summary: Returns the command-line argument at index as a string. Call it as builtin.get_arg(index).
